description: This file defines a React functional component named 'CartScreen' that renders a static shopping cart page UI. It reconstructs a design exported from Figma using absolute positioning, CSS classes, inline styles, and image assets. The component includes UI elements such as a status bar, title, search bar, filter button, product card, bill summary, and a proceed-to-pay button.

methods.description: React functional component rendering the static cart UI.
